note: Background world of each rung (TARGETS section 2 'Rungs'). World subject n is placement:w<n> -> worker:w<n> with 5 facts (lib/gen.mjs worldOps), loaded through the bulk lane in batches of 100 subjects (one command each, commandId world/<rung>/<seed>/batch-<k>), idempotently, into the scope gs-world-<rung>-s<seed>-<gen hash>. The full N01 subject world (50 to 2,000 facts, 3 to 6 hops) replaces this when lab/bench lands. goldenSubjects is how many world subjects carry O-REPLAY digests (all of them at 10k).
